description: GET ONLY the 'Challenge' field of TitlePublicConfigurationModel. Challenges — scheduled chains of side events (Arena, Boss, ...) paid with ONE shared ticket per chain. Milestones of main events and leaderboards grant the ticket with the short address {Type: Challenge, EntityID: ChainID}; it lands in whichever phase is running. Each phase has its own points (earned only by successful attempts) and milestones. Leftover tickets convert at phase end via Ticket.BurnConversion (e.g. into dice).
name: get_challenge
title: Get Challenge settings
